caption: The video captures a person's bare forearm and hand extending from the left edge of the frame, gripping a small cylindrical device with a silver barrel, black ringed rim, and dark top knob. The scene is an outdoor passage between buildings, but the right two-thirds are blown out to white by extreme overexposure, leaving only a windowed wall, a dark sky patch, a faint yellow ground line, and a touch of green foliage. The arm stays held out at mid-frame while the device turns gradually in the grip, the ringed rim rotating to face more toward the viewer as the barrel tilts a little. The hand and device remain near the same position, while the white area and background shift only subtly. No objects enter or leave, and the held orientation keeps adjusting slowly throughout.
relations: The hand's grip on the knob permits the ringed rim to rotate slowly toward the viewer.
As the rim turns, the silver barrel tilts slightly while the forearm stays extended at mid-frame.
The device's position remains near the same spot relative to the blown-out white background.
The windowed wall and yellow ground line shift only subtly as the held orientation adjusts gradually.
